text: {"memo": "Coming into the 2025-03-31 note, Cisco Systems appeared at the end of FY2024, its fiscal year ended July 27, 2024. FY2024 revenue was $53.9 billion, up 0.8% versus FY2023 revenue of $53.0 billion, as networking demand softened while security and AI-related networking demand provided a modest offset. Net income was $10.7 billion in FY2024, with diluted EPS of $3.74. Cash flow from operations was about $14.5 billion in FY2024, and free cash flow roughly $8.5 billion. Gross margin was about 62% and operating margin about 28% in FY2024. For FY2023, revenue was $53.0 billion, up 17.5%, net income was $9.9 billion, EPS was $3.74, and cash flow from operations was about $14.0 billion. FY2022 revenue was $43.0 billion, up 18.4%, net income was $6.9 billion, EPS was $2.50, and cash flow from operations was about $12.0 billion. The business slowed sharply in FY2024 after two strong growth years, with modest revenue guidance ahead. The stock's view: Cisco remains a cash-generative, diversified networking leader, but FY2024 results and the AI monetization timeline warrant a cautious stance."}
